structured_output.summary: The change replaces the stub with a thin implementation of Map.prototype.clear. It calls the existing this_map helper, which does RequireInternalSlot and propagates the TypeError with `?`. It then calls map_table(...).clear(), which empties the entries in place so suspended iterators stay valid. It returns undefined. Each spec step has a comment above its code. Only the one in-scope file changed, and the parameters were renamed with underscore prefixes. The gate report shows build and clippy ok, and 14 new passes with 0 regressions on the target. I could not see the helper sources, only the diff. The comment's claim that OrderedTable::clear empties entries in place rather than removing them is therefore taken on trust. The test results fit that claim.
